acceptance: Seeded tpch_skew and tpchavoc DataFrame runs bind the same qgen parameters as the SQL run, with an equal-bindings test at two seeds
Dry-run with --seed previews the seeded SQL
description: TPC-H DataFrame runs now bind the parameters qgen draws for a seed (#2595, #2604), but tpch_skew and tpchavoc DataFrame runs still ignore --seed and bind qgen -d defaults, and `benchbox run --dry-run --seed` previews qgen -d SQL. A seeded run of these benchmarks compares SQL and DataFrame results for different parameters.
